name: Jacob Christmann
bioAdditions: The Reichenbach baptism of his daughter Maria Elisabetha (9 Aug 1729, baptized 14 Aug) names her parents as Jacob and Anna Margaretha Christmann of Kollweiler (recorded in Round 4 under H0072). That confirms him as her father and gives his wife's first name. He was dead by her marriage on 19 Sep 1752.
